request.prompt:
Use case: website hero video for a coaching platform
Primary request: create a polished product-demo style shot of the One To One coaching platform being actively used on a modern laptop and phone
Scene/background: clean premium desk setup in a bright fitness-coaching studio, soft daylight, subtle reflections, no visible human face
Subject: the One To One interface with a client dashboard, Action Hub, next 7 days planner, weekly summary, trainer overview, and a message thread from a coach
Action: a user sits just out of frame and uses the laptop and phone; the cursor glides through the dashboard, highlights the Action Hub, scrolls the 7 day planner, opens a trainer message, then returns to a calm overview state
Camera: cinematic over-the-shoulder three-quarter angle, slow dolly in with a slight right-to-left parallax move, stable screen-focused framing, premium commercial feel
Lighting/mood: warm, trustworthy, motivating, organised, modern
Color palette: deep navy, charcoal, crisp white, teal accents, soft amber highlights
Style/format: realistic product commercial, clean UI motion, subtle depth of field, high screen legibility, no glitching
Timing/beats: beat 1 establish laptop and phone with the One To One dashboard open, beat 2 highlight Action Hub and planner, beat 3 reveal trainer message and progress cards, beat 4 settle on the full platform overview
Text (verbatim): "One To One"
Constraints: keep the experience focused on coaching, planning, progress tracking, and trainer-client communication; show believable software interactions; no visible face; no copyrighted brands other than the One To One product name
Avoid: messy desk clutter, exaggerated sci-fi holograms, unreadable UI, rapid camera moves, flicker, warped hands, extra devices, watermarks
